'''Docking Bay 10''' was a [[Hangar/Legends|docking bay]] located at a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lamuir IV]]. Docking Bay 10 was once used by [[House Pelagia]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Pellas Agri]] to berth his [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], ''[[Starseeker]]''.<ref name="MF">{{WEGCite|story=The Mecetti File|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref>
